project_extensions.scope: Collider Monte Carlo model, process, beams, weights, native parton LHE and truth cutflow.

acceptance_criteria: Genuine native MG5 fixed source, LO photon-only process, seed 27183 and 5000 positive common-weight LHE events.
Born cross section within max(0.5%, five integration standard errors), raw event momentum residual at most 2e-5 GeV.
Truth acceptance within five binomial standard errors of 0.728; malformed event controls rejected.
Exact native gzip and separate normalized read-view fingerprint.
